mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.text: Authors whose books trained an AI are paid only part of what they are owed now, and the rest waits on the AI company's own IPO or big investment. The writers' final cheque is tied to the company's next funding round.
mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.rests_on: the final payment of about $450 million is due within about 30 days of Anthropic's IPO or a significant investment, and no later than September 2027

mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.text: The payout to authors is down to the cent, $2,203.56, and it is still only approximately 70 percent of what they get.
mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.rests_on: "Only approximately 70 percent ($2,203.56) will be paid out now"

mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.text: A settlement over writing has needed tens of thousands of corrections to its own paperwork.
mon/554f7348-ecc3-45cb-888d-9a8afe61b9bf.rests_on: "tens of thousands of claims have been corrected"

mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.text: Warner wants AI music to boost its streaming revenue, and has also signed deals that take fully AI-made tracks out of the royalty pot. AI is welcome to make the label money, just not to be paid like an artist.
mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.rests_on: Warner has expanded deals requiring fully gen-AI content to be identified and removed from pro rata royalty shares

mon/f5721a93-5b59-4d86-b53e-24bc70510d84.text: Warner's "fiscal '27" sounds a year off, but in label time it began on 1 October 2026.

mon/013ae567-6e91-4c57-9128-9ce85eef667c.text: ITV's free AI ad maker worked as a recruiting tool for its human creative team: five of its first 16 users went on to hire the people.
mon/013ae567-6e91-4c57-9128-9ce85eef667c.rests_on: five of the 16 later moved to ITV's in-house creative team with bigger TV budgets

mon/013ae567-6e91-4c57-9128-9ce85eef667c.text: A year of free AI TV ads brought in 16 small businesses, a number you could fit around one meeting table.
mon/013ae567-6e91-4c57-9128-9ce85eef667c.rests_on: GenAI Ads Manager drew 16 new-to-TV small and medium-sized businesses in its first year

mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.text: An AI music company did not just skip paying songwriters' royalties; its website hands customers a ready-made template to cancel their licences.
mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.rests_on: YourNeuroTune's website offers customers a template to cancel existing BumaStemra licences

mon/80baed3f-3833-4bce-9afd-040a4868e562.text: The rights society gave the company a deadline down to the hour, noon on 25 November, before saying it would see it in court.

wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.text: Open a session in Suno's new Ableton app and it uploads your whole project and its audio files to Suno. The tool that adds AI stems also takes a copy of your song.
wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.rests_on: when a session is opened, Bridge uploads the Ableton project and its audio files to the user's Suno account

wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.text: Each AI stem is priced in Suno's own currency: 10 credits a go, out of 10,000 for $30 a month.
wed/cf6e7746-6ce2-4c68-904a-d1ae1988bef9.rests_on: each generation costs 10 Suno credits; Premier costs $30 a month with 10,000 credits

wed/972b7721-4e4e-477f-b5cf-20164fd8260c.text: Suno, a company built on making music from other people's music, has added filters so its new video tool will not copy specific artists or copyrighted works.
wed/972b7721-4e4e-477f-b5cf-20164fd8260c.rests_on: Suno added filters to block prompts that depict specific artists, public figures or copyrighted works

wed/972b7721-4e4e-477f-b5cf-20164fd8260c.text: The music video tool tops out at 15 seconds, shorter than most choruses.
wed/972b7721-4e4e-477f-b5cf-20164fd8260c.rests_on: it makes lyric videos, album art and clips of up to 15 seconds

wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.text: To stop strangers using your face, you first prove it is your face, by handing your ID to a third party.
wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.rests_on: "sign up by verifying their ID with a trusted third-party partner"

wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.text: The checker for AI fakes covers CapCut and Dreamina, apps people use to make AI images and video.

wed/08442c41-534a-4523-9818-0884e2fc985a.text: TikTok says it has put an AI label on about five billion uploads.

wed/8c6c717d-00b4-4d26-b837-06b89709220a.text: A musician lost two appeals to YouTube over his own song, then got it back about a day after a reporter sent one email.

wed/8c6c717d-00b4-4d26-b837-06b89709220a.text: The company that claimed his music runs about 500 YouTube channels.

fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.text: At Ubisoft, a game pitch that leaves out AI reportedly needs a reason, as if making things by hand were the risky choice.
fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.rests_on: one source said "If you planned on not using it, you would have to have a reason"

fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.text: Ubisoft's AI unit is called Motherbrain.
fri/16b1fd4f-3785-4842-9a2b-19ccfe889fa8.rests_on: Motherbrain is "a dedicated subsidiary developing proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators" (Yves Guillemot)

fri/5d55e729-43fd-433b-b4e5-056f5329cb05.text: In one year, designers who use AI weekly went from just over half to nine in ten.
fri/5d55e729-43fd-433b-b4e5-056f5329cb05.rests_on: 91% of designers use AI at least weekly, up from 54% a year earlier

fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.text: The AI animated feature needed a co-writer, editors, colourists, a Foley artist, a sound team and a cast of professional voice actors. Plenty of people still had a job on the AI film.

fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.text: The AI film's sound team still spent four days in a real studio in Stockholm on the mix.
fri/a4b34048-ab39-49da-a251-eaa58ebe2eaf.rests_on: the sound team spent four days in a Stockholm studio on the theatrical mix

fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.text: At the first AI music awards, the voters were AI artists, and they gave the top three prizes to an AI avatar.
fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.rests_on: winners were picked by AI artists who are members of the Sonic Intelligence Academy

fri/ac13c2b0-5426-4018-aaeb-eed82b9d0a6c.text: The AI artist of the year has a human who wrote all of its lyrics.

tue/photonstems.text: Software can now pull up to six separate voices out of one recording, on an ordinary computer.

tue/splicecreate.text: Splice's new music app is free to make in, and charges at the moment you want anyone to hear it.

tue/freeanimation.text: Motion capture, the stuff of studio stages, now runs from a webcam, free.

sat/goodnews.text: Someone built a game painted with about 1.5 million brush strokes in every frame, in hours.
